channel.title: TallyBloom — budget, planner and tracker spreadsheets
channel.description: Budget, planner, tracker and bookkeeping spreadsheets. Instant downloads for Excel and Google Sheets.

item.title: Annual Budget Template 2026 — 12-Month Budget Spreadsheet + Debt Tracker
item.description: See your whole year of money in one file. 12 monthly budgets, a year summary that calculates itself, savings rate and a debt payoff tracker. Works in Excel and Google Sheets. Instant download. #budgetspreadsheet #budgetplanner #2026budget #moneytips

item.title: Bookkeeping Spreadsheet for Small Business — Income & Expenses Template
item.description: Log what comes in and what goes out. Monthly profit, quarterly totals and how much to set aside for tax are calculated for you. For freelancers and solo businesses. Excel and Google Sheets. #bookkeeping #smallbusiness #freelancer #selfemployed

item.title: Biweekly Budget Template — Paycheck Budget Planner for Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Paid every two weeks? Plan every paycheck before it lands: which bills it covers, how much goes to savings goals, and what is safe to spend. Excel and Google Sheets. Instant download. #paycheckbudget #biweeklybudget #sinkingfunds #budgeting

item.title: Christmas Budget Planner & Gift Tracker — Google Sheets & Excel Template
item.description: Plan Christmas without the January money shock. One budget, a gift list with planned vs spent, bought and wrapped tick-offs, and a warning if you go over. Excel and Google Sheets. Instant download. #christmasbudget #giftlist #christmasplanner #holidaybudget

item.title: 2027 Budget Planner — Annual Budget Template for Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Plan all of 2027 in one file: 12 monthly budgets, a year summary that fills itself in, expected pay for any pay cycle, your own currency, and a debt tracker. Excel and Google Sheets. #2027budget #budgetspreadsheet #budgetplanner #newyear

item.title: Simple Budget Template for Google Sheets & Excel — Any Pay Cycle
item.description: A budget simple enough to actually keep up: type each payment on one tab and your monthly summary and category totals fill themselves in. Weekly, biweekly, 4-weekly or monthly pay, your own currency. Excel and Google Sheets. #budgetspreadsheet #simplebudget #budgettracker #moneytips

item.title: Assignment Tracker Template — Homework Planner & Grade Calculator
item.description: Every assignment, due date and grade in one place. See what is overdue, what is due this week, and your current grade in every class, worked out from your points. Excel and Google Sheets. #assignmenttracker #studentplanner #gradecalculator #homeworktracker

item.title: Split Expenses Spreadsheet — Group Trip Cost Splitter for Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Log every shared expense once, and see what each person paid, their fair share and whether they owe or get money back. The Settle Up tab shows who pays whom, and how much, so everyone ends up even. Excel and Google Sheets. #grouptravel #expensesplitter #tripexpenses #splitcosts

item.title: Job Application Tracker — Job Search Template for Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Log every application, see its status at a glance and get a Follow up now alert when a follow-up date comes due. The dashboard works out your response rate, interview rate and how many applications you sent this week and this month. Excel and Google Sheets. #jobtracker #jobapplication #jobsearch #interviewtracker

item.title: Lead Tracker Template — Simple CRM Spreadsheet for Small Business
item.description: List every lead with its source, stage and deal value, and the date you next need to follow up. The dashboard shows your pipeline by stage, the weighted value of open deals, won revenue, your win rate and which lead sources bring in the business. Excel and Google Sheets. #leadtracker #clienttracker #salestracker #crmspreadsheet

item.title: Scholarship Tracker Template — Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Keep every scholarship, deadline and requirement in one list. See what is due soon, what you still need to write or request, how much you have applied for and how much you have won. Excel and Google Sheets. #scholarship #collegeplanner #studentplanner #collegetracker

item.title: Tip Tracker for Servers — Tips & Hourly Wage Spreadsheet
item.description: Log each shift's hours, cash tips, card tips and tip-out. The sheet works out your net tips, total earned and real hourly rate, month by month, and shows which job and shift type pays best. Excel and Google Sheets. #tiptracker #servertips #bartendertips #shifttracker

item.title: Travel Budget Template — Trip Planner & Itinerary Spreadsheet
item.description: Plan the whole trip in one file: a day-by-day itinerary with the dates filled in, every booking with what is still to pay, and a budget that shows planned vs actual by category. It also works out cost per traveler and per day, and keeps your packing checklist. Excel and Google Sheets. #tripplanner #travelbudget #travelplanner #itinerary

item.title: Wedding Guest List & RSVP Tracker Template — Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Your whole guest list, RSVPs, meal choices and table plan in one file. The summary counts people, not rows, so you always know how many are coming, what to tell the caterer and which thank-you notes are still to write. Excel and Google Sheets. #weddingguestlist #rsvptracker #weddingplanner #seatingchart

item.title: Recipe Cost Calculator — Bakery Pricing Spreadsheet for Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Type what you pay for each ingredient once, build each recipe from a drop-down, and see what a batch and a single item really cost, including packaging and your time. Pick a profit margin to get a suggested price, then log orders to see your profit month by month. Excel and Google Sheets. #recipecost #bakerypricing #cakepricing #homebakery

item.title: Craft Fair Vendor Tracker — Sales & Inventory Spreadsheet for Makers
item.description: List your events and your products once, then log each sale by picking the event and the item from drop-downs. See the profit and profit per hour of every event, which event did best, and how much stock you have left. Excel and Google Sheets. #craftfair #vendorspreadsheet #craftshow #marketvendor
